description: Count contacts who match an audience now (audienceCount) and how many are known to have your app connected (appUserCount, a lower bound). Everyone in the audience gets the campaign the next time their app fetches the feed, including contacts who join while it is live. If appUserCount is 0, say Sequenzy hasn't seen their app connect yet; if in-app isn't set up, point to Settings > In-app.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

targetLists.description: Audience, same shape as campaign targetLists: {"type":"all"}, {"type":"lists","listIds":[...]}, {"type":"segment","segmentId":"..."}, or {"type":"rules","include":[...],"exclude":[...]}. Each contact is checked against it when their app fetches its feed while the campaign is live, so people who join the audience later get it too.

name: estimate_in_app_campaign_recipients

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `estimate_in_app_campaign_recipients` MCP tool.

appUserCount.description: Of those, contacts known to have your app connected (an active iOS or Android device, or an in-app message their app displayed). A lower bound.

audienceCount.description: Contacts who match the audience now.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
